steps.content: This is an exquisitely decorated perfumery. Numerous perfume bottles are displayed in tall cabinets, creating a magnificent sight.
The unblended essential oils, fragrances, and extraction equipment scatter around the room, making it clear even to a layman like you that this place belongs to a top perfumer.
Elisa, Anna, Marilyn...

Each delicate and transparent perfume bottle carries a handwritten name tag. But upon closer inspection, you realize that besides the containers filled with finished perfumes, the glass bottles that seem to store ingredients are also labeled with names.
They contain a crimson liquid and an ivory-colored powder. Some of them have barely been touched, while others are almost empty.
Are these... the raw materials of your perfumes?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: That's right. Each of them carries a unique scent that yields a distinctive perfume, perfectly recreating the youthful vitality of those beauties...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It's safe to say that no one else but I can truly uncover the fascinating essence within these fragrances...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It's lucky for both me and them that they got to meet me, be used by me, and become part of the perfumes I make.
Quality ingredients and an excellent craftsman are indeed a match made in heaven.
If you're already so happy with your craftsmanship and works, why did you host all these perfume galas in such a short time to find more sources of inspiration?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: ...Because I'm not yet satisfied.
Cassia's fingertips trace over the names one by one as she whispers.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Their fragrances don't last long enough. On top of the combination and variation of notes, longevity and projection are also two important things to consider when making a good perfume...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: You can smell it too, right? Although this fragrance is wonderful, it also vanishes quickly. A perfume made from this ingredient can't possibly be long-lasting...
Cassia picks up a bottle of perfume and sprays it in the air above. The sweet and wonderful scent immediately falls upon both of you, enveloping your bodies.
But in just a moment, that enchanting scent disappears just like a stranger slipping past swiftly.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: That's why I can only continue searching... for more and better quality fragrances, a rich scent that never fades...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I've been searching for a long, long time. Sometimes I found hope, but more often I was let down... until I smelled your scent!
Cassia's tone grows more and more impassioned, but she suddenly stops. Abruptly, she leans in to inhale the scent between your neck and hair obsessively.
You...!
You quickly step back, cautiously watching her. But she is scanning over every detail of your body with an extremely attentive gaze.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Clear, but rich. Light, but firm. Warm, but frigid... A scent that perfectly fits my requirements, and yet still manages to surprise me.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: If I have you... I can definitely create the legendary Immortal Fragrance... I'm sure of it!
Her gaze clings to you like a shadow, filled with obsessive, admiring, and drenched desire. That's not the look one gives to an equal intelligent being... Not the look one gives to a person.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Ah... How wonderful. Before my favorite perfume runs out, I've finally found the best fragrance! I feel blessed to have met you!
Fragrance. She refers to you as a fragrance. In her eyes, you are no different from a rockrose branch or a bunch of juniper berries or tonka beans.
Did you think of them... the same way?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: What?
...Where are these people whose names you put on your labels?! What have you done to them?!
At your question, Cassia looks around and then lets out a rare laugh. Her gorgeous laugh sends a chill down your spine.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Why ask such an obvious question? You just need to look around... and you'll find the answer yourself.
Cassia opens the storage cabinet, revealing rows of neatly arranged perfume bottles before you. They all refract mesmerizing lights, their dazzling beauty leaving you breathless.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Look at them, smell them. These are their reincarnations, the sweetest fragrances...
You are rendered speechless by her matter-of-fact attitude when suddenly a loud noise comes from behind you.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: I knew you were behind all this! I knew it all along! You've abducted my Fleur and hid her...

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Not this one... And not that one either! Just you wait, I'll definitely find her. I'll find the evidence that you took my daughter!
You're shocked to see the intruder is in fact Lucas. You can't imagine how this ordinary man managed to tail you all the way here, driven by sheer determination and a glimmer of hope.
There might be traces of Mania in those fragrances. Stay back, Lucas!
Lucas obviously eavesdropped on your conversation. Cassia's words ignited the sorrow and pain that he had accumulated over many years, turning them into this burning anger.
He has given up rational thinking. Ignoring your instinctive attempt to stop him, he rushes toward the perfume bottles and checks the labels one by one.

Eventually, he picks up a small glass bottle with trembling hands. You see the name Fleur written on the label in beautiful cursive. This seems to be the last straw that destroys Lucas's sanity. He turns to Cassia.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: What else do you have to say! My daughter... Where on earth is Fleur?! What have you done to her!!!
Facing both of you, Cassia remains absurdly serene as usual. Lucas's anger has no effect on her, and your vigilance feels like a breeze to her.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: That's why you barged into my territory reeking of dirt, to look for her... No, to look for the gift she's left me, right?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: What gift?! Fleur would never leave you any gift! Stop playing dumb, you mad woman! Where have you hidden her?!
Despite his previous frustration, Cassia's words have clearly given Lucas a glimmer of hope that his daughter is still alive.
You can practically read his thoughts from his violently shaking pupils and trembling hands that are still carefully holding that perfume bottle.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Fleur... is such a kind-hearted, friendly girl... What if she's made friends with this crazy woman? What if she's survived, and that's why her name isn't in the perfume catalog?
Utter despair can turn a person's anger into blazing fire. But now, this mixture of despair and hope is dragging his limbs like heavy silt.
The grieving father doesn't realize he's looking at his supposed enemy with hopeful eyes, eager to hear the sparing of his daughter's life from her mouth.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Fleur... Oh, Fleur.

The name seems to evoke melancholy in Cassia too. You can feel that on the other side of the shackles, her emotions are fluctuating violently among bitterness, pain, and relief... The boiling emotions under her calm exterior are surprisingly similar to Lucas's.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: If it hadn't been for Fleur's help... I definitely wouldn't have survived until today.

Base notes:
incense, moss, metal.

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Yes, I was adopted, but I don't see anything wrong with that. Father is a learned and cultured man. He never berates us and is very fair with rewards and punishments... You should be able to adapt quickly too.

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: Fair with rewards and punishments? What do I need to do to be rewarded? Will he be willing to let me go?

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Well... Just like me, you can help Father look for beauties in the slums and bring them back here. Though without a sharp sense of smell like mine, it may be more difficult for you...

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: But Father's greatest hobby is to collect and admire beautiful people. If you can do it as well and efficiently as I do, there's hardly any request he wouldn't agree to.

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: You mean, like what you did to me? Lure innocent people back here to earn rewards?

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: What I wanted was not the rewards, I wanted to help you.

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: Help me?

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: You were in threadbare clothes adorned only with some flowers and your hands were calloused. I also smelled the pungent cheap detergent... Father always says this is how poor folks with a harsh life look like, but a beauty like you shouldn't suffer like this.

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: I brought you back here so you could live well. Father favors beauties like you. You can live happily here, just like I do.

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: You think you were helping me when you brought me back?

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: This place is indeed luxurious, with many expensive clothes and jewels and premium foods... But you have no friends or family here. Everything feels cold and you can't go out whenever you want.

steps.speaker: Tough Girl
steps.content: You've lived here since you were young. Don't you ever find this confined lifestyle suffocating?

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Not at all. I'm doing well here, and I have everything I need. Why would I find it suffocating?
At that moment, the beauty named Fleur stared at Cassia with a look full of sadness and sympathy.

The young Cassia couldn't understand her, nor did she try to. She firmly believed in her own happiness, just as she was educated and indoctrinated to, in this house constantly filled with a lingering fragrance.

The incense in the mansion was frequently replenished, and the beauties in the rooms came and went. She thought all this was normal. Those beauties were just like carpets that got switched out with the seasons, not deserving extra attention or thoughts.
Until disaster and terror finally descended upon her.

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: What is... this smell? It smells rusty... and sweet...

Following this smell that should have been forbidden in the collector's perfect mansion, Cassia came to the usually locked collection room. The heavy door that had always been closed in her memory was ajar, revealing only a corner of the sinful sight.

That was the scene that changed her life. The woman who had just talked to her not long ago was lying on the bench, her life seeming to have faded away with the rosy complexion now gone from her ashen face. Cassia's world collapsed with her.
She probably hit the door lock in her terror. The collector, who was cleaning something by the bench, turned around and found the petrified Cassia standing by the door.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Oh, it's you, my darling Cassia. What's wrong? Did you smell the decay of the beautiful flower?

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Father... What are you doing...?

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Just some preparation work. You know I'm a naturalist. I never interfere with the growth and change of my collectibles.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: After all, beauty in its natural state is the least greedy, and the most original and valuable... As an admirer, my biggest involvement in their lives is just to provide them with some convenience and aid in life. That's the ideal case.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: But that's assuming they are still seedlings in my garden and items on my display shelves.

He took out a silk handkerchief and wiped the water droplets trickling down the cleaned knife. Cassia could sense the displeasure hidden under his usual gentle tone, as dangerous as the sharp blade wrapped in expensive silk.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: I've always been very lenient with my collection. All I ask of them is just to stay beautiful and self-disciplined. Who else in DisCity could be as generous, asking for nothing in return?

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Sadly, some of my collectibles fail to appreciate my kindness and even try to escape from the showcase I've carefully prepared for them.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: The most unreasonable behavior is to spoil their own grace and squander the gift they've been bestowed with.
The collector's deep regret sounded genuine, which inexplicably terrified Cassia even more that she began to tremble uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: So I'm just trying to save the beauty from disappearing completely, just like saving a withering flower. Clean it, soak it, and preserve it so that it can bloom eternally...

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Cassia, my daughter, my confidante... Come and help your father complete this noble task.
Cassia obediently came to the collector's side as he gestured. With every step closer, another face that had vanished silently flashed across her mind.
The pungent bloody stench, accompanied by inexplicable pain and unease, invaded her senses, making Cassia feel as if even her internal organs were seized.
But she couldn't pay attention to those emotions now, because the collector pointedly tapped her cheek with the knife, leaning affectionately into her ear to say.

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Speaking of, little Cassia, your face doesn't look as beautiful as before up close...

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: I'm so sorry, Father. I apologize...
Even though the collector only tapped her with the back of the knife, Cassia was still extremely terrified.
She nervously glimpsed at the weapon tapping her face with her peripheral vision, horrified at the possibility that one of these taps might scratch her skin, making her a valueless defective product.
The extreme tension gave Cassia the illusion that the increasingly intense bloody smell came from wounds on her body.
In her illusion, one after another bloody scratches appeared on Cassia's face. The never-healing wounds emitted a foul stench, sapping her vitality and pronouncing her death.

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Please... Father, please forgive me...

steps.speaker: Collector
steps.content: Fear not, Cassia. Fear only distances you from your beauty. As my daughter, you above all must remain beautiful.
Slowly, silence returned to the collection room. Even though everything had been cleaned up, Cassia could still smell the bloody stench lingering around her.
She mechanically followed the collector's instructions, repeating the cleaning procedure. But her mind was fully occupied by the fear brought by the bloody scent.
Suddenly, she smelled a mesmerizing fragrance emanating from her hands. The scent overpowered the stench and soothed her mind.

steps.speaker: Young Cassia
steps.content: Fleur, Fleur... Is it you? Are you comforting me? Fleur...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It was only after that moment that I realized I'd gained a special ability.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I could create a perfume that erased the scent of fear and also use it to preserve my youth... If it hadn't been for Fleur's help, I probably wouldn't have been able to stay beautiful until my father's death...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Everything I have now, I owe to Fleur... She was the first fragrance that brought me peace and my most precious collectible. I would never let any tasteless stranger see her...

That's why after all this time searching, Lucas has gotten very close to the truth, but never close enough to actually locate his daughter. This twisted, horrifying story leaves you in shock for a long while.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Fleur... My Fleur was so kind and beautiful... How could you do this to her...
He seems devastated by the bad news of his daughter's long-ago death. His trembling hands can't hold the perfume bottle anymore. It slips and falls to the ground.

A wonderful rich scent immediately fills everyone's noses. But unlike what Cassia said, this scent doesn't smell peaceful or soothing. Instead, it brings a crashing wave of sadness, making one unable to hold back their tears.
Everyone seems to see and hear the girl whispering to Cassia before closing her eyes:

steps.speaker: Fleur
steps.content: Don't be afraid.

Cassia falls to the ground. She reaches out her trembling hands and grabs the broken perfume bottle, pulling it into her arms. The shards cut her hands, bringing out the unsettling smell of blood already hidden in the perfume.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Of course I know how beautiful Fleur was! How truly wonderful is her fragrance... That comforting scent is almost irreplaceable! That's why I've been cherishing her, just so I can keep her with me a little longer...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: All this time, I've been trying, but I've never been able to make a perfume that can replace Fleur... And yet you've spoiled my one last bit of her scent...!

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: What am I supposed to do... There won't be another Fleur. She can't comfort me when I'm in pain anymore...
Despite her usual calmness, Cassia is having an outburst now. She murmurs to herself neurotically, picking up a perfume bottle next to her and pointing it at Lucas.
Her boiling anger and aggression shake the shackles. You can't ignore her impending urge to use her ability.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No... Let go of me!! He... he destroyed my Fleur! My most precious Fleur! Only she can comfort me, only she can protect me!
I won't let you hurt anyone anymore. Stop, Cassia.
You release the shackles and subdue all of Cassia's actions, peering down at her.
You clearly saw the collector in his true colors, why did you continue to stay by his side? Were you using him to get in touch with more victims?
Indeed, the collector was the culprit who hurt Lucas and his daughter, but you were complicit in Lucas's long struggle of losing his beloved daughter too, can you deny that?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No... It's not like that... Only those beauties can free me from fear and bring me peace... They are essential to me, I need them just like a person needs air and water...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: So I found a way to acquire them and make perfume out of them. What's wrong with that? Doesn't it also elevate the value of their lives when they satisfy my desires and soothe my spirit? It's a win-win.
For a moment, there is only silence. You finally realize Cassia's surprise is genuine. She's truly unaware of what's wrong with her actions.
She's both a perpetrator and a victim.

The twisted education from the collector and her abnormal childhood have shaped her into a monster who's obsessed with fragrance and only knows how to satisfy her own desires with no regard for any ethical rules. This flaw will require long-term supervision and reeducation to rectify.
Whether it's for her or for public safety, you must detain and control her.
Cassia, you are now under the control of the MBCC. I will not allow you to treat people as mere perfume ingredients anymore. You must undergo my supervision and education.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Haha, suit yourself with your accusation and supervision... I will never give up capturing and collecting fragrances of beauties... Unless...
She stares at you like a predator staring at its prey.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Unless you're willing to replace Fleur and become the ingredient for the Immortal Fragrance of my dreams... Only your unique fragrance can surpass even Fleur's scent. I'll only concede in that case...
I refuse. The moment you came to the MBCC, you've become my responsibility. I will never let you harm others anymore, nor will I let you commit evil deeds in the name of perfumery.
As for your mental issues, I will regularly use the shackles to rectify them. Even if a cure is impossible, it can at least prevent future breakdowns from losing your fragrances.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Don't turn me down so quickly. Why don't you try my special perfume? I guarantee it will make you...
That is non-negotiable.
Cassia seems reluctant to accept this outcome, but under the shackles' restraint, she has long lost her say and can do nothing to defy you.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Fleur... My poor Fleur...

Before bringing Cassia back to the Bureau, you can't help but check on Lucas. He is kneeling in front of the shattered perfume bottle, muttering to himself as he tries to piece together the fragments. It's as if by doing so, he could retrieve the last traces of her daughter, now vanished in the wind.
The shattering of Fleur's perfume hasn't only dealt irreparable damage to Cassia, but also to this father whose determination has been met with a devastating end.
Even more regrettably, since the perfume is a product of Cassia's special power, you can't let Lucas have it, despite your heartfelt sympathy and grievance.
Please accept my condolences. Unfortunately, the perfume cannot be returned to the victim's family. But I promise we will send back any belongings or remains of Miss Fleur that we discover.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: ...It's my honor to be of help.
...What?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: When Fleur used to do laundry to help out with the expenses, she would never ignore someone in need even if she was running late... And she always said that after helping someone...

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: My daughter was smart and kind... She didn't forget to help the poor little girl even till the very end...
He shakes his head bitterly.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: If she were still alive, she would definitely say this.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: At least no one else will suffer like I did.
Alone in her room, Cassia dips a strand of black hair into the perfume bottle in front of her. She inhales deeply, luxuriating in the smell.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Hehe...
